articles.content:
很多人一听到'编程式'三个字，第一反应就是：我又不会写代码，这不是程序员专用的吗？

大错特错！在 2026 年，编程式 AI 软件的真正含义，不是要求你去敲代码，而是给 AI 提供一套具备编程架构的物理运行环境。

在这个环境里，AI 模型不再只是一个只会吐字的说客，而是一个拥有系统最高权限、带有一整套生化机械臂的超级执行官。

来看四款真正的重型武器：

第一款：谷歌反重力平台（Antigravity）

这是谷歌专为高阶智能体打造的重型工作台。在反重力平台里，你面对的不是单一模型，而是一个可以自主分工的 Agent 兵团。

昨天gemini 3.6 flash更新了，全网都在骂谷歌不行了，gemini垃圾。

其实，我的体验而已，是非常棒，太牛了。

速度太快了，超级快，质量也很OK，吊打国内AI。

这篇文章，就是gemini 3.6 flash写的初稿。

为什么？

因为，fabel5 和 workbuddy还在慢慢思考。

第二款：Codex 桌面控制端

如果说反重力平台是多兵种联合作战指挥部，那 Codex 就是深入系统底层的工程装甲车。 [...] 为啥，因为最近免费，无限token，太爽了，昨天我又让我帮我干了个通宵。重写了我的57篇付费的Ai专栏文章，每篇都强制5000字以上。

3｜普通人不写代码，为什么更应该选择杀鸡用牛刀？

写到这里，我知道很多读者心里在打鼓：

'老周，你说得都对。但我就是个做运营的/做行政的/写文案的，我连 Git 是什么都不知道，我怎么可能去用谷歌反重力平台、Codex 或者 Cloud Code？'

这正是大多数人最深沉的认知误区。

在 AI 时代，技术壁垒的倒塌是双向的。

在过去，只有顶级程序员才配使用 IDE 和命令行，因为你需要记忆几百个复杂的指令和语法；但在 2026 年，编程式 AI 软件已经彻底被自然语言统一了。

你在 Cloud Code 或者反重力平台里，根本不需要敲任何一行 C 语言、Python 或 Bash 代码。

你只需要用日常的汉语粗话向它下达指令，和在网页版聊天一模一样简单。

而且使用超级简单，就是下一个桌面客户端而已。

工具推荐和资源清单：表现最强，适合长期做。典型爆款是 2026-04-22 德国 0.02 欧元 eSIM，1764 赞、300 转、2450 收藏、48.1 万浏览；2026-03-02 agent-browser，951 赞、197 转、1642 收藏。用户喜欢原因是"稀缺资源 + 低成本 + 立刻可用"。应增加，但必须从搬运升级为"筛选标准 + 使用场景 + 风险提醒 + 替代方案"。

articles.content:
Put multiple bots in one group chat and they coordinate without you.

They pass work between each other. They assign ownership. They pull you in only for judgment calls.

You give the group an objective, not a task list.

A task list means you already did the decomposition.

An objective lets the bots split it, which is the whole point.

The handoff, one bot deciding another is better suited and passing ownership, is something that did not exist in any AI tool before this. [...] Still in early beta. Because bots click through real interfaces, a redesigned layout or random popup can trip them. Anything touching money, legal, or live customer emails needs a guardrail.

Hand it reversible, low-stakes jobs first. Watch the early runs more closely than you think you need to. Only let it off the leash once it has earned it.

Who this is actually for:

→ If your AI budget is $20/month and you are still learning, this is not your next step. Get fluent with Claude first. [...] One of their engineers described previous personal agents like this:

"Configuring, provisioning, delegating, and triaging instead of doing useful things."

Grok Bot inverts that.

You describe a job in a sentence.

The bot has the computer, the logins, the memory, and the time.

You have the decisions.

That shift from prompting to delegating is the entire thing.

articles.title: Rohit
articles.content:
AI stopped being a thing you talk to. It became a thing you build around.

  Once you see it that way, the rest of 2026 makes sense in a way it did not a year ago.

  The year prompts stopped mattering

  Two years ago the winning skill in AI was prompt engineering. You learned the right phrasing, the right persona, the right chain of thought, and you got better outputs than the person next to you. That skill had a half-life of maybe eighteen months. [...] This is why every serious AI team in 2026 is obsessing over the same set of problems. Context management. State persistence. Tool reliability. Error recovery. Permission systems. Observability. None of these sit inside the model. All of them sit in the layer around it. [...] A month from now you will be looking at the person still typing prompts into a chat window and wondering how you ever did it that way.

  That is what 2026 is. Not a better model year. Not a benchmark year. A year where the people who stopped talking to AI and started building around it ran away with the next decade of leverage.

  The rest of this year is about whether you join them now or catch up later.
